description: Interface defining service methods for deposit account operations in the Fineract savings portfolio, including account activation, transactions, transfers, charges, and maturity updates.

classes.name: DepositAccountWritePlatformService
classes.description: Service interface for deposit account operations in savings portfolio.

methods.name: activateFDAccount
methods.description: Activates a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: activateRDAccount
methods.description: Activates a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: updateDepositAmountForRDAccount
methods.description: Updates deposit amount for recurring deposit account.

methods.name: depositToFDAccount
methods.description: Deposits funds into a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: depositToRDAccount
methods.description: Deposits funds into a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: withdrawal
methods.description: Performs withdrawal from a deposit account.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for a deposit account.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts calculated interest to the account.

methods.name: undoFDTransaction
methods.description: Undoes a fixed deposit transaction.

methods.name: undoRDTransaction
methods.description: Undoes a recurring deposit transaction.

methods.name: adjustFDTransaction
methods.description: Adjusts a fixed deposit transaction.

methods.name: adjustRDTransaction
methods.description: Adjusts a recurring deposit transaction.

methods.name: closeFDAccount
methods.description: Closes a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: closeRDAccount
methods.description: Closes a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: prematureCloseFDAccount
methods.description: Prematurely closes a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: prematureCloseRDAccount
methods.description: Prematurely closes a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: initiateSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Initiates transfer of savings account.

methods.name: withdrawSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Withdraws a savings transfer.

methods.name: rejectSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Rejects a savings transfer.

methods.name: acceptSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Accepts a savings transfer.

methods.name: addSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to a savings account.

methods.name: updateSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Updates a charge on a savings account.

methods.name: deleteSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Deletes a charge from a savings account.

methods.name: waiveCharge
methods.description: Waives a charge on a savings account.

methods.name: payCharge
methods.description: Pays a charge on a savings account.

methods.name: applyChargeDue
methods.description: Applies due charges to an account.

methods.name: updateMaturityDetails
methods.description: Updates maturity details for a deposit account.

methods.name: mandatorySavingsAccountDeposit
methods.description: Performs a mandatory deposit transaction for savings account.
